# Anbennar Overhaul: generated by tools/build_rie_courts.py from Realms in Exile and Anbennar.
# Anbennar Overhaul: do not edit by hand; rerun the generator after an RiE, Anbennar or CK3 update.
# Realms in Exile backgrounds and royal courts (tools/data/rie_courts.py). Character scope.

# RiE dwarven court (Durin's Folk)
aov_rie_court_dwarf_trigger = {
	exists = capital_province
	culture = { has_clothing_gfx = aov_dwarf_clothing_gfx }
	capital_province = { OR = { terrain = dwarven_hold terrain = dwarven_hold_surface terrain = dwarven_road terrain = cavern } }
}
aov_rie_court_dwarf_above_kingdom_trigger = {
	aov_rie_court_dwarf_trigger = yes
	highest_held_title_tier > tier_kingdom
}
aov_rie_court_view_dwarf_above_kingdom_trigger = {
	OR = {
		aov_rie_court_dwarf_above_kingdom_trigger = yes
		AND = {
			exists = primary_spouse
			primary_spouse = { is_ruler = no aov_rie_court_dwarf_above_kingdom_trigger = yes }
		}
		betrothed ?= { aov_rie_court_dwarf_above_kingdom_trigger = yes }
		host ?= { aov_rie_court_dwarf_above_kingdom_trigger = yes }
	}
}
aov_rie_court_dwarf_kingdom_trigger = {
	aov_rie_court_dwarf_trigger = yes
	highest_held_title_tier = tier_kingdom
}
aov_rie_court_view_dwarf_kingdom_trigger = {
	OR = {
		aov_rie_court_dwarf_kingdom_trigger = yes
		AND = {
			exists = primary_spouse
			primary_spouse = { is_ruler = no aov_rie_court_dwarf_kingdom_trigger = yes }
		}
		betrothed ?= { aov_rie_court_dwarf_kingdom_trigger = yes }
		host ?= { aov_rie_court_dwarf_kingdom_trigger = yes }
	}
}
aov_rie_court_dwarf_duchy_trigger = {
	aov_rie_court_dwarf_trigger = yes
	highest_held_title_tier = tier_duchy
}
aov_rie_court_view_dwarf_duchy_trigger = {

		}
		betrothed ?= { aov_rie_court_dwarf_duchy_trigger = yes }
		host ?= { aov_rie_court_dwarf_duchy_trigger = yes }
	}
}
aov_rie_court_dwarf_below_duchy_trigger = {
	aov_rie_court_dwarf_trigger = yes
	highest_held_title_tier < tier_duchy
}
aov_rie_court_view_dwarf_below_duchy_trigger = {
	OR = {
		aov_rie_court_dwarf_below_duchy_trigger = yes
		AND = {
			exists = primary_spouse
			primary_spouse = { is_ruler = no aov_rie_court_dwarf_below_duchy_trigger = yes }
		}
		betrothed ?= { aov_rie_court_dwarf_below_duchy_trigger = yes }
		host ?= { aov_rie_court_dwarf_below_duchy_trigger = yes }
	}
}
aov_rie_court_scene_dwarf_trigger = {
	NOT = { government_has_flag = government_is_nomadic }
	exists = capital_county
	aov_rie_court_dwarf_trigger = yes
}

# RiE Lasgalendrim court (Greenwood)
aov_rie_court_wood_elf_trigger = {
	exists = capital_province
	culture = { has_clothing_gfx = aov_lasgalendrim_clothing_gfx }
}
aov_rie_court_wood_elf_kingdom_or_above_trigger = {

	highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom
}

# Liches (data.LICH_BACKGROUNDS)
aov_lich_court_unlanded_trigger = {
	has_trait = lich
	is_landed = no
}
aov_lich_court_view_unlanded_trigger = {
	aov_lich_court_unlanded_trigger = yes
}
aov_lich_court_landed_trigger = {
	has_trait = lich
	is_landed = yes
}
aov_lich_court_view_landed_trigger = {
	OR = {
		aov_lich_court_landed_trigger = yes
		AND = {
			exists = primary_spouse
			primary_spouse = { is_ruler = no aov_lich_court_landed_trigger = yes }
		}
		betrothed ?= { aov_lich_court_landed_trigger = yes }
		host ?= { aov_lich_court_landed_trigger = yes }
	}
}

aov_rie_court_scene_trigger = {
	OR = {
		aov_rie_court_scene_dwarf_trigger = yes
		aov_rie_court_scene_wood_elf_trigger = yes
		aov_rie_court_scene_moon_elf_trigger = yes
	}
}
